scope: All seven known historical DA3 jobs with the frozen robust-section reader; engineering and applicability replay, not independent method efficacy or blind qualification
freeze_note: Keep every original valid depth pixel in the materialized base. No confidence pruning, no new fitting, no GT choice of accepted targets. Both complete base and base plus all historically accepted segments use the same pre-existing RGB guide union and fixed readout scales derived from base camera span. Suppression empty in this replay; deletion verified separately with analytic source-ID tests.
engineering_revision: Fourth reader: robust circular sections with fitted centers, radius relative to axial span, and coherent side-arm rejection. All 198 analytic cases are development. No changes to historical candidate geometry, ROI, cameras, readout scales, source points or scoring tolerances.
